title: Jubilant Crispy Thai Oranges Boat Noodles
description: A malty, crispy, and energizing Thai dish featuring oranges and boat noodles, inspired by Southern Thai cuisine, with a Mediterranean-friendly twist. This nimono-simmered dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the malty soy sauce, palm sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Add the orange segments to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce and oranges.
Transfer the noodles to a serving boat or bowl.
Garnish with crispy fried shallots, toasted peanuts, and chopped cilantro.
